name: Aggregated wind farm measurements benchmark study
description: A comparative benchmark study that uses aggregated wind farm measurements to monitor and evaluate wind turbine performance and detection methods.
general_score_metric: RMSE / MAPE (error metrics for forecasting) or F1 for detection tasks
reputation: A domain-specific comparative study used within wind-energy research for method evaluation rather than a widely adopted standardized ML benchmark.
notes: Domain-specific, real-world measurement data with site- and season-specific variability; relatively small and specialized dataset; not applicable to LLM benchmarks.
